response.rationale: The vignette shows classic lichen planus features (oral lichenoid plaques, nail changes, histopathology) plus positive anti-HCV and raised liver enzymes, directly supporting hepatitis C-associated lichen planus. R1 captures the general diagnosis but omits the HCV association; R4 is too narrow, focusing only on nails.

rejected.why: Only addresses nail findings, ignoring oral lesions and HCV status, which are integral to the presentation.
Correct for lichen planus but lacks the specific HCV association that is explicitly present and clinically relevant.
